Walk: 900 m NE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 3 m, about 18 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-31, Region 3. Season: moose spike fork bulls Oct 15 to Nov 15 (synopsis page 34, 99%). 2 legal flags below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-04, private land 2026-09-22, closures 2026-10-03.
